ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var ids = (payload.parts filterObject ((v, k) -> k as String == "attachmentId")) pluck $ var files = (payload.parts filterObject ((v, k) -> k as String == "files")) pluck $ --- files map (filePart, index) -> { attachmentId: ids[index].content, fileName: filePart.headers."Content-Disposition".filename, content: filePart.content, contentType: filePart.headers."Content-Type" }

logger.message: #['Subiendo archivo ' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' con Attachment ID: ' ++ payload.attachmentId]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.azureResults + { fileName: vars.fileName, status: "uploaded", blobPath: vars.fileName }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.azureResults + { fileName: vars.fileName, status: "failed", error: error.description }
